summary: Our Project LUNOVA Is an educational model inspired by ISRO's LVM3-M4 launch vehicle, which carried Chandrayaan-3 towards the Moon. It represents India's achievements in space science and demonstrates the importance of rocket technology in lunar exploration. Our project aims to inspire young minds to explore space, develop scientific curiosity and dream beyond boundaries.
details: PROJECT LUNOVA is a model of ISRO's LVM3 rocket. It demonstrates how rockets carry spacecraft into space. It helps us understand rocket technology, lunar exploration and space science while developing creativity, teamwork and scientific knowledge.
